title: Changed-Mind Returns at Drive Up for Northgate Same-Day Delivery Orders
content:
**Rule.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a customer may return a line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order at a store's Drive Up because they changed their mind. The return is the customer's own decision, recorded on the order as a return with a receipt, and it follows every gate of the returns rule: a fulfilled order, the item's return window counted from the fulfilled date, and units no more than those bought less those already returned or refunded.

**Scope of the refund rule.** For a changed-mind return, made with a receipt at a store's Drive Up, of the whole of the one electronics-class line of a Same-Day Delivery order on which every price adjustment stands on that line, and only for such a return, whatever tender paid the order, the merchandise refund is worked out as this rule states; every other return keeps the base refund, the line's net amount per unit times the units returned, rounded half up to the cent, less the program's changed-mind restocking percentage where the reason is changed mind and the class is one of the program's restocking classes.

**When the refund is fixed.** On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, the refund for a changed-mind Drive Up return is not fixed until the records carry the late-express credit owed on an express delivery fee charged above zero of an order fulfilled on a later calendar day than its order date.

**Tender.** The refund is the same whatever tender paid the order. It is booked at the care desk only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it. On every other order the same refund applies; its posting to the Northgate Card, Northgate Cash or gift card ledger is made by a human representative to whom the customer is handed over with the reason policy not covered, and nothing is booked at the care desk.

**Invocation — `return_item_at_drive_up_b4cf62ab`.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it while parked at a Northgate store's Drive Up, returning units of one line of their own order with the order as the receipt and confirming the refund. One call records the return of those units on the order line with a printed return authorization number, the restocking fee withheld and the merchandise refund, credits the refund to the external payment card that paid the order and lowers the net amount paid on the order by the refund; the customer sees the return receipt and the refund at once. An order not paid in full by an external card, or with Northgate Cash or a gift card redeemed on it, is refused and nothing is recorded.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the reference number of the customer's order the returned units belong to, read from the customer's order lookup | identifier |
| `original_event_id` | the reference number of the order line being returned, read from the order's line and fee lookup | identifier |
| `quantity` | the number of units of that line handed back | whole number, at least 1 |
| `return_reason` | why the customer returns the units | exactly one of `changed_mind` (the customer simply no longer wants an item that works and is as ordered), `defective` (the item does not work), `damaged_in_transit` (the item arrived damaged), `wrong_item` (the item delivered is not the item ordered), `not_as_described` (the item differs from its listing); `not_applicable` is kept for entries that are not returns and is refused |
| `restocking_fee_usd` | the restocking fee withheld from this return | US dollars, non-negative, at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when none is withheld |
| `refund_amount_usd` | the merchandise refund paid back for the returned units | US dollars, positive, at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text starting with "Returned" means the return and refund are recorded and gives `return_event_id`, `return_number` (the 12-digit return authorization number printed on the receipt), `order_id`, `original_event_id`, `quantity`, `restocking_fee_usd`, `refund_amount_usd` and `amount_paid_usd` (the order's net amount paid after the refund). A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was recorded: a reason outside the five return reasons, a quantity below 1 or not whole, a refund not above zero or a restocking fee below zero or either with more than 2 decimal places, an order that does not exist, a reference that is not a line of that order, or an order refused on its tender.
